cohort: 321 women who underwent cesarean delivery with a fully dilated cervix and a fetal head at the level of the ischial spines or below
finding: While no difference in overall intraoperative uterine incision extension rate was observed, the 'legs first' method may lower maternal morbidity in cases with a prolonged second stage of labor.
mod_finding: Fetal extraction using the 'legs first' method during a cesarean section after a prolonged second stage of labor may reduce maternal morbidity.
